dialogue_texts: What a peculiar sight for a festive time.
Kozankyo is usually so meticulous, and yet here is a trail of paper like the falling leaves.
Argh... No... Confound it! Where have they all gone?
It seems the "glohm" I was warned about has already begun to disrupt the simple task of delivery.
Or perhaps a very disorganized person.
Oh! Sorry. Very sorry. I didn't notice you were standing in my way!
You should mind your surroundings, little one!
The Empress doesn't simply 'stand in the way'. I am the path itself.
I'm trying to deliver the mail to the residents, but I've lost so much of it.
A tragic loss for the residents, I'm sure.
I tend to be clumsy and often lose the things I'm trying to deliver.
I also didn't take the chance to introduce myself.
The name's Kotori Tegami - a tengu who delivers the mail to Kozankyo's residents.
And I'm Empress Kaguya of the People's Kingdom of Gensokyo.
Now I know which ruler you are! Why are you in Kozankyo?
I have a more pressing engagement with a 'toxic rumor' that is threatening the upcoming festival.
So this means you can't help me?
I'll be searching thoroughly for a while...
I can't, I have a crucial deadline approaching.
If time is your currency, let me see if you can afford a duel with me.
Time is money... you'll see me fired without it!
